title: Reversible Edit History & Project Versioning
objective: Provide deterministic edit commands, undo/redo, autosave and recovery boundaries, and project-version lineage for SAA authoring without mutating sealed owner-domain truth or granting later derivative/export/share authority.
acceptance: Authoring mutations are represented as deterministic reversible commands with stable identity and replay order.
Undo and redo restore exact authored SAA presentation state without guessing or silently rewriting owner-domain references.
Autosave and recovery have explicit durable boundaries and distinguish committed project state from transient/incomplete edits.
Project versions preserve lineage, parent identity and deterministic replay/recovery relationships rather than duplicating external owner truth.
Corrupt, stale, incompatible or incomplete history/recovery state fails closed and remains inspectable instead of being silently repaired.
Keyboard/textual equivalents can inspect history, version and recovery state without requiring drag gestures.
Provider-off local operation remains supported; optional AI and paid cloud are not required.
SAA-14 and later derivative registration/export/share/publication/SMB10B behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-13 owns SAA-local edit history, recovery boundaries and project-version lineage only; owner-domain Character, Scene, ARI, narrative and other canonical truth remain external.
Undo/redo/recovery may restore authored SAA state only and may not mutate or synthesize canonical owner-domain records.
No automatic semantic rewriting, derivative registration, export/share/publication or final Creator integration authority is granted.
SAA-14 remains blocked until verified SAA-13 closeout.
next_action: Establish causal RED for deterministic reversible SAA edit commands, undo/redo, autosave/recovery boundaries and project-version lineage; then implement only SAA-13.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner Continue governed-started SAA-13 after verified SAA-12 closeout.
